Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be
commented on by investigating officer).

On the 29-8-38, an article entitled "Punish
the Traitorous Merchants" was published in the
secret publication of the "Unity" ( combined
issues No. 28 and 9), which is the mouthpiece of
Local National Salvation Elements, a translation
of the article reads as follows.

"Eliminate a 'rice worm'

"Sung Chueh-sung (宋菊生), a native of
"Wusih and a salesman of cereals and flour
"by profession, lives at 23 Tung Yu Li,
"Tiendong Road. Recently he purchased a
"large quantity of Chinese rice from various
"rice shops. It is estimated that he buys
"between 5,000 and 6,000 bags a day. The rice
"is stored in the 'enemy's' godown for
"military uses.

"Sung Chueh-sung collects provisions for
"the 'enemy' and is in fact a pest to his
"race. It is hoped that all will rise and
"eliminate him."

The article was made the subject of special
Branch Misc. 8719/38 and investigations made by
D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken, he, on the 8-9-38 made enquiries
at Sung Chueh Sung's residence No. 23/347 Tiendong
Road and learned that on the 2-9-38 Sung Chueh Sung
received a threatening letter, purporting to
emanate from a "Youths Iron and Blood Corps "
(青年鐵血團) and contained the following
sentence "Chueh Sung: pay attention to your
movements." According to the post mark, the

备注
（任何突出或特殊的特征需由调查警官评论）。

1938年8月29日，一篇题为《惩治奸商》的文章发表在“团结社”（Unity）的秘密刊物（第28期和9期合刊）上，该刊物是地方救国分子的喉舌，文章译文如下。

《铲除一只“米虫”》

“宋菊生（Sung Chueh-sung），无锡人，
“职业为谷物和面粉销售员，
“居住在天潼路同余里23号。最近他从各家
“米店购买了大量中国大米。估计他每天
“购买5,000至6,000包。这些大米
“储存在‘敌人’的仓库中，供军事用途。

“宋菊生为‘敌人’收集物资，实际上是他
“种族的祸害。希望众人起而
“铲除他。”

该文章成为特别科杂项档案 8719/38 的主题，并由侦探督察高延根（Kao Yen Ken，音译）进行调查，他于1938年9月8日在天潼路347弄23号宋菊生住所进行查问，获悉宋菊生于1938年9月2日收到一封恐吓信，声称来自“青年铁血团”（青年鐵血團），信中包含以下句子：“菊生：注意你的行动。”根据邮戳，

letter was mailed from the 22nd Branch of the Post

At A.M. on the 12-9-38 the letter was forwarded
to West Hongkew Station and now forms the subject of
this F.I.R.

At 10 A.M. on the 12-9-38, C.D.S. 68 and the
undersigned visited and made further enquiries at
No. 23/847 Tiendong Road and learned that Sung Chueh
Sung who is 42 years of age and a native of Chingpo,
formerly carried on business at No. 9 Woo Shing Li,
Wong Ka Mo Doo, Nantao and removed to his present
residence during December 1937. He has been doing
business with the Japanese for some considerable time
and all his transactions are done through the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce, his last transaction being appro-
ximately 10 days ago when he sold "Bran" to the value
of $7,000.00 to the Mitsue Bussan Kaisha Coy. No. 49
Szechuen Road.

Sung Chueh Sung now known as the complainant,
states that he has had no other communication from the
alleged "Youths Iron and Blood Corps or from any other
source and is of the opinion that the letter is from
someone who intends to try and extort money from him.

The complainant has now been instructed to inform
the station of any further developments, whilst the

信件于1938年9月2日上午11时从极司菲尔村（Jessfield Village）邮局第22支局寄出。

1938年9月12日上午，该信件被转送至西虹口巡捕房，现构成本初步调查报告（F.I.R.）的主题。

1938年9月12日上午10时，刑事侦缉警士（C.D.S.）68号与签署人前往天潼路847弄23号并进行进一步查问，获悉沈菊生（Sung Chueh Sung，此处原文拼写与前文宋菊生略有不同，依前文及中文名为沈菊生/宋菊生，此处按音译保留或统一，鉴于前文已定沈菊生，此处指同一人）现年42岁，青浦（Chingpo，音译，通常指青浦）人，此前在南市区王家码头路（Wong Ka Mo Doo，音译）五兴里9号经商，于1937年12月搬至现住址。他与日本人做生意已有相当长一段时间，所有交易均通过华人商会进行，最近一笔交易大约在10天前，他以7,000.00美元的价格向四川北路49号的三荣商事会社（Mitsue Bussan Kaisha Coy.，音译）出售了“麦麸”。

沈菊生（现称为报案人）称，除所谓的“青年铁血团”外，未收到来自该团体或其他来源的任何其他联络，并认为这封信是有人试图向他勒索钱财。

page_data.en:
September 9, 38.

A cereal merchant in West Honkew District receives warning
from a Youth's Iron & Blood Corps.

An article entitled "Punish the Traitorous Merchants"
(original attached), a summarized translation of which is
given hereunder, appeared in the secret publication "Unity"
Combined Issues No.28 and 29, dated August 21, 1938, which
is the mouthpiece of local national salvation elements:-

"Eliminate a 'rice worm'
"Sung Chueh-sung (沈菊生), a native of Wusieh
"and a salesman of cereals and flour by profession,
"lives at 23 Zung Yu Li, Tiendong Road. Recently
"he purchased a large quantity of Chinese rice from
"various rice shops. It is estimated that he buys
"between 5,000 and 6,000 bags a day. The rice is
"stored in the 'enemy's" godown for military uses.
"Sung Chueh-sung collects provisions for the
"'enemy' and is in fact a pest to his race. It
"is hoped that all will rise and eliminate him."

Enquiries were therefore made at Sung Chueh-sung's
residence, Lane 847 (Zung Yu Li), 23 Tiendong Road, on
September 8. It was ascertained that he received through
the mail a letter purporting to emanate from a "Youth's
Iron & Blood Corps" (青年铁血团) on September 2.
The letter contained only the following sentence "Chueh-sung:
Pay attention to your movements !". The original letter
is forwarded herewith. According to the post mark, the
letter was mailed from the 22nd Branch of the Post Office,
Jessfield Village, at 11 a.m. September 2.
page_data.zh:
1938年9月9日。

虹口西区一名谷物商人收到“青年铁血团”的警告。

题为《惩治奸商》的文章（原件附后），其摘要译文如下，刊载于1938年8月21日出版的秘密刊物《团结》第28、29期合刊上，该刊物是本地救国分子的喉舌：——

“铲除‘米蛀虫’
“沈菊生，吴县人，
“职业为谷物及面粉推销员，
“住天潼路宗余里23号。近期
“他从各家米店大量购入华米。
“据估计，他每日购买量在
“5,000至6,000袋之间。这些大米
“被储存在‘敌人’的仓库中，供军事用途。
“沈菊生为‘敌人’征集物资，实乃民族之蠹。
“望众人起而除之。”

因此，于9月8日对沈菊生的住所进行了查询，地址为天潼路宗余里847弄23号。经查实，他于9月2日通过邮件收到一封声称发自“青年铁血团”的信件。信中仅包含以下一句话：“菊生：注意你的行动！”原信随文附上。根据邮戳显示，该信于9月2日上午11时从极司菲尔村（Jessfield Village）邮局第22支局寄出。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Although Sung Chueh-sung received the letter of
warning a week ago, no report was made to the West Hongkew
Station.

Nothing is known of the "Youth's Iron & Blood Corps".
According to Special Branch records, copies of an anti-
Japanese handbill bearing on the "August 13" Anniversary
and purporting to emanate from a "China Youth's Iron & Blood
Corps" were surreptitiously disseminated on Robison Road,
O.O.L. and in Louza District on August 7, 1938.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

尽管沈菊生于一周前收到了这封警告信，但并未向虹口西区警署报告。

目前对“青年铁血团”一无所知。根据特务处记录，1938年8月7日，有人秘密散布了若干份反日传单，内容涉及“八一三”周年纪念，并声称发自“中国青年铁血团”，散布地点为罗宾森路（Robison Road）、O.O.L.及老闸区。
